520241.name: Vulcan Cannon
520241.description: Fires a barrage of rifle bullets, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

520242.name: Fang Missile
520242.description: Fires many missiles from its left shoulder, dealing damage. It will no longer fire missiles once its left shoulder has been destroyed.

520243.name: Beam Cannon
520243.description: Fires a laser from its shoulder, dealing damage to a single Nikke.

520244.name: Storm Generator
520244.description: Creates a tornado, dealing damage to all Nikkes.

520245.name: Lightning Control
520245.description: Unleashes a thunderbolt, dealing damage to multiple Nikkes.

520246.name: Overdrive
520246.description: Unleashes a magnetic field, dealing damage to all Nikkes. Must be interrupted via Special Interruption; otherwise, the magnetic field will be unleashed and any Nikke hit by it will be rendered temporarily unable to act.
